title: refactor(Development/AbelianVarietyTheory/Proofs): generalize MulNonsingInvCancelRightGram Lie-Fock lemmas to single-place vacua
body:
Generalize `GlobalTheory.LieFock.exists_lift` and `GlobalTheory.LieFock.exists_raise_lower` in `MulNonsingInvCancelRightGram.lean` to single-place Fock vacua, move `GlobalTheory.LieFock.lieFockUpTo_at` there (deriving `lieFockUpTo` from it), update the two `exists_raise_lower` call sites in `LieActionFockOperatorsScalarsTrace.lean`, and remove the duplicated proofs from `WeilDatumRealDerivativeFockVectorsAll.lean` (also delegating `lie_entry'` to `GlobalTheory.LieFock.lie_entry`).

Moves `GlobalTheory.LieFock.lieFockUpTo_at` from `WeilDatumRealDerivativeFockVectorsAll.lean` to `MulNonsingInvCancelRightGram.lean`, removes `GlobalTheory.LieFock.exists_lift_on` and `GlobalTheory.LieFock.exists_raise_lower_at` from `WeilDatumRealDerivativeFockVectorsAll.lean`, and generalizes `GlobalTheory.LieFock.exists_lift` and `GlobalTheory.LieFock.exists_raise_lower` in `MulNonsingInvCancelRightGram.lean`.
